text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kh... To think that I couldn't even
place on the board...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, state the reason for this outcome within one second!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, there's no denying that.
There's no way King is lacking in talent, after all."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"However, luck is something you can draw to yourself
if you have the strength to seize it!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If I lack the power to draw luck to my side,
then I just need to train even harder.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I shall grant you the right
to draw out my luck and power to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, strive with all your might!!
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped... then. I really hate this,
I truly hate it, but just for now, I'll acknowledge you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Look at it the other way: if you build up genuine strength, you can climb even higher.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I have wings.
Wings in the form of inborn talent!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If you have great wings to soar to the top with,
then all that's left is to practice flapping them!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I am King Halo!
I will never, ever give up!
